svg.title: LayoutInflater 选择 Factory2 或 Factory，再按空结果回退
svg.desc: 工厂返回 View 时直接使用，不继续回退；Factory2 返回空不会必定再调用普通 Factory。 图中两条工厂分支互斥；缓存只省查找，View 构造、主题和资源成本仍在 when Factory2 exists use it；only absent Factory2 allows ordinary Factory；null Factory2 result may fall back to private Factory；null selected ordinary Factory result may fall back to private；still null uses normal creation；neither Factory2 nor Factory is configured；with no configured public factory result remains null and tries private fallback

text.tspan: Factory2 不存在且 Factory 存在
图中两条工厂分支互斥；缓存只省查找，View 构造、主题和资源成本仍在
